purpose: Offline, verifiable brand identification in investigative diagrams. Asset provenance is independent from address attribution.

ethereum.label: Ethereum
ethereum.provenance: Ethereum official ethereum.org brand assets page links this glyph SVG.
ethereum.use_restrictions: Official brand asset. Trademark rights are separate from site/source-code licenses; preserve design and avoid implying endorsement.

tornado-cash.label: Tornado Cash
tornado-cash.provenance: Logo in the archived Tornado Cash project organization classic UI repository; fixed commit a83fae0772c8da084c0e76b3a756b456f5b9f5bb.
tornado-cash.use_restrictions: Repository is MIT licensed (see pinned LICENSE); retain attribution when redistributing source. Logo/trademark rights remain distinct. Original mint fill is preserved.

uniswap.label: Uniswap
uniswap.provenance: Uniswap official organization brand-assets repository; protocol unicorn icon, not Uniswap Labs wordmark; pinned commit 1d829912a8b1c154b700984f88baa83142ee1a1b.
uniswap.use_restrictions: Official brand asset. No blanket trademark/relicensing permission is asserted; preserve logo and follow the brand owner’s applicable guidelines.

kucoin.label: KuCoin
kucoin.provenance: KuCoin official Media Kit page embeds this current mini-logo CDN URL in site configuration. Official-domain page establishes CDN provenance.
kucoin.use_restrictions: KuCoin trademark. Download does not confer endorsement or blanket reuse rights. This is the brand available on retrieval date, not evidence that the 2020 artwork was identical.

tether.label: Tether USD₮
tether.provenance: Tether official Media Assets page explicitly provides the green Tether Logo Mark SVG.
tether.use_restrictions: Subject to Tether Media Assets brand/copy guidelines and any required permission; keep colors/proportions and do not imply endorsement.
